title: Chat GPT shortcuts revolutionize prompt responses with 10 #ChatGPT #AIAssist #ProductivityTips
description:
Chat GPT introduced 10 short codes that transform how it responds to prompts. These codes range from simplifying explanations (ELI5) to summarizing lengthy texts (TLDR), providing honest answers (truth mode), debating opposing views (steel man), breaking down reasoning (step-by-step), delivering expert-level responses (like a pro), formatting data into tables, applying the 80/20 principle, using Socratic questioning, and auditing plans for improvements.

These codes enhance user interaction by offering precise control over response style, depth, and format. They help users achieve clearer understanding, uncover biases, improve planning, and save time in retrieving information effectively. This innovation streamlines communication with AI, supporting diverse needs from casual explanations to professional analyses.

Adopting these codes can boost productivity and critical thinking by tailoring AI outputs to specific requirements, making complex tasks more manageable across education, business, and research environments.
